name: digitutor
description: A study tutor that lives in your system tray: hit a hotkey, it screenshots your screen, listens to your question, and answers with AI.
author: Alp Iskin

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run check:sdk-pin && npm run check:key-storage
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run geticon && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run geticon && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run geticon && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.ship: npm run dist && npm run release:web && npm run deploy:web
